steps.title: Write the sample projects
cmux:
mkdir -p /tmp/cmux-tour-projects/web-app /tmp/cmux-tour-projects/rust-cli /tmp/cmux-tour-projects/notes /tmp/cmux-tour-projects/cmux && cd /tmp/cmux-tour-projects && printf '{"name":"web-app","dependencies":{"next":"15.0.0","react":"19.0.0"}}
' > web-app/package.json && printf '[package]
name = "rust-cli"
version = "0.1.0"
' > rust-cli/Cargo.toml && printf 'notes
' > notes/README.txt && git -C cmux init -q && git -C cmux remote add origin https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux.git; clear
